from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Form from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from jinja2 import Environment, BaseLoader import logging import os app = FastAPI(title="Internal Report Generator", version="2.1.0") logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) # Template environment for dynamic report generation jinja_env = Environment(loader=BaseLoader(), autoescape=False) # Internal configuration SERVICE_NAME = os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "report-gen") INTERNAL_API_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_API_KEY", "") def validate_internal_request(request: Request) -> bool: """Basic validation for internal service mesh requests.""" api_key = request.headers.get("X-Internal-Key", "") if INTERNAL_API_KEY and api_key != INTERNAL_API_KEY: return False return True @app.get("/health") async def health(): return {"status": "healthy", "service": SERVICE_NAME} @app.post("/api/v1/render-report", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def render_report( request: Request, template_body: str = Form(...), report_title: str = Form(default="Untitled Report"), department: str = Form(default="Engineering"), ): """Render a custom report template with provided variables. This endpoint is used by the internal dashboard service to generate PDF-ready HTML reports from user-defined templates. """ if not validate_internal_request(request): return HTMLResponse(content="Unauthorized", status_code=401) # Build context for template rendering context = { "title": report_title, "department": department, "generated_by": SERVICE_NAME, "timestamp": __import__("datetime").datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), } try: # Render the user-provided template with context variables compiled_template = jinja_env.from_string(template_body) rendered_html = compiled_template.render(**context) except Exception as e: logger.error(f"Template rendering failed: {e}") return HTMLResponse( content=f"

Render Error

", status_code=400 ) # Wrap in basic HTML structure full_html = f""" {report_title}

environment.description: Service runs as ECS Fargate task in isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway attached to VPC). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/dashboard-service-role. The VPC endpoint's security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) permits inbound TCP 443 only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/24 (the dashboard service subnet). No route table entry exists for 0.0.0.0/0 in the task subnet. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS name (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890-abc123.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com). There is no public DNS record. The ECS task role has no network-facing permissions beyond the VPC endpoint connection.
